title: collatz-settlement
description: A strict-finite settlement: the F_U-orbit of a collatz-increment-sequence. v_τ(reached)(k)=t iff k is reached by stage τ; the family is ≤_k-monotone; κ (the stage of last new cell) is the total stopping time and the well-founded measure. Each stage carries the nucleus-shadow direction of its step and the residue mod 6.

kappa.description: Closure ordinal κ < ω: the stage at which the last new cell is acquired = the total stopping time. Existence of a finite κ for every seed is the Collatz conjecture in regime form.

cellsReached.description: |v_κ|, the size of the settled valuation.

stages.description: The orbit (v_τ). Each element is a stage's increment.

nucleusShadow.description: transferring-shadow = Δ (odd, expansion); saturating-shadow = σ (even, contraction).

residueMod6.description: n_τ mod 6 — surviving commutating-closure modulus lcm(2,3-1).

newCell.description: Whether this stage acquired a not-previously-reached cell (false ⟺ at/after quiescence).
